generation_prompts.food_atlas:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent inventory sprite atlas for a historical Chinese survival game.
Generate a brand-new square 1024x1024 PNG with real alpha transparency. Exactly 4 columns by 4 rows, 16 equal invisible 256x256 cells, strictly row-major. Each cell center is (128,128), (384,128), (640,128), (896,128), then y=384,640,896. All cell coordinates are conceptual, NEVER draw numbers, guides, text, borders or grid lines. Keep each object entirely within its cell, centered, at least 15% fully transparent margin from each cell boundary. Do not rearrange, center the group, swap, duplicate, merge or omit objects. Transparent background absolutely everywhere outside the objects; no surface, floor, panel, label, background texture, drop shadow or cast shadow.
Style: a cohesive set of lovingly worn old-world mundane goods: hand-painted realistic gouache and dilute watercolor with restrained soft ink outlines, muted warm earthy pigments, tactile rough matte wood/clay/cloth/metal, honest natural wear. Chinese rural late-imperial everyday objects. Grounded, rustic, legible small item silhouettes; not cartoony, not vector, not pixel art, not a glossy game render. No glow, rim light, specular shine, plastic, metallic sparkle, harsh black outline or modern commercial packaging. Soft restrained ambient illumination. Three-quarter view where useful, slight elevated view for bowls. No readable words or characters anywhere. Items with simple motifs use tiny unlettered painted symbols only. This is an inventory atlas, one self-contained object or explicitly requested bundle per cell. All objects drawn in the same scale of visual detail, not to real-world scale.
EXACT CELL CONTENTS:
Row 1: C1 one plain round steamed flatbread with a lightly creased pale wheat surface; C2 a short coarse clay jar with visible pickled dark green leafy vegetables at the open mouth; C3 one broad hanging cured pork strip with muted reddish brown meat and cream fat bands; C4 three whole warm beige chicken eggs.
Row 2: C1 one complete pale green napa cabbage with layered leaves; C2 one complete white daikon radish with short green leaves; C3 a tied bundle of long slender deep green chives; C4 one whole reddish brown reishi mushroom, characteristic lacquer-free kidney-shaped fan cap and short stem.
Row 3: C1 a rustic wooden dipper filled with clean clear water, visible water surface; C2 a coarse ceramic bowl of plain white rice porridge, visible swollen rice grains; C3 one thick yellow coarse millet cake with crumbly grain texture; C4 a rough ceramic bowl of clear green vegetable soup, scattered green leaves in translucent broth.
Row 4: C1 a rice bowl with fried rice and small cured pork pieces, golden brown and cream grains; C2 three distinct white sticky rice cakes resting on one green leaf; C3 a rough ceramic bowl of clear pale broth with yellow egg ribbons; C4 a rounded mound of sticky rice pudding decorated with eight small differently colored dried fruit and nuts, visible rice grains.
Repeat: exactly 16 separate sprites, one per prescribed cell, fixed row order, 15% transparent margins. No utensils or garnish beyond the specified item.
